svg.title: Candidate supermarket locations and walking access in Havering
svg.desc: Two equal-scale maps of the original walking network around the Emerson Park candidate and candidate near Elm Park. Coloured dots represent the 13 and 19 output-area centroids counted within a 15-minute walk, corresponding to 4,517 and 6,589 residents. Whole-area populations are counted; this is not address-level access. Existing supermarkets are square marks. Demand forecasts are compared separately within the study.

g.text: Winkels: Geolytix · Kaarten op gelijke schaal
